# Isoline

> Isoline is a free, open-source (MIT) Python command-line tool for financial statement analysis of any listed company. One command (`isoline scan TICKER`) computes the Piotroski F-score, Altman Z''-score and Beneish M-score, quality metrics, four years of income statement, balance sheet and cash flow, a DCF valuation, and writes a print-ready report laid out like a published annual report, with every number explained in plain English. Missing data shows as n/a, never a zero. Data comes from Yahoo Finance, with SEC EDGAR as a fallback for US tickers. Not investment advice.

Install: `pip install isoline` (Python 3.10+, Windows, macOS, Linux). Current version: 0.9.0. Formerly named Telmus.

## Commands

- `isoline scan TICKER`: scores, metrics, terminal tables, HTML and Excel reports
- `isoline statements TICKER`: four years of financial statements, as reported
- `isoline compare A B`: two companies side by side
- `isoline screen SECTOR`: screen a sector with criteria
- `isoline value TICKER`: DCF valuation with scenarios and sensitivity
- `isoline serve`: MCP server so AI assistants can call Isoline
